content.short: PizzaTon is a TON launchpad for sharing ideas, raising capital, and getting startup feedback.
content.description: PizzaTon is a TON launchpad and founder-support app. Its TON App listing describes a dedicated space where founders can share ideas, receive feedback from experienced builders, raise capital, connect with other creators, and access training or mentorship. The product is closer to early-stage project support than to a trading or wallet app. PizzaTon is included because it helps the TON ecosystem with launch, discovery, fundraising, distribution, or early project visibility. PizzaTon is kept in this TON set because its product has a concrete user or builder workflow, not only a loose mention of the network.
